about.text: Accessibility reviewer: which doors of the Duplex are narrower than the 850 mm minimum, and where are they? Rule (an assumption, not legal advice): a door on an accessible path needs at least 850 mm clear width, as NBC 2020 (National Building Code of Canada) 3.8.3.12 is cited by the NRC door check (samples/nrc/door_verdicts.csv, rule DC-W1, marked illustrative); the 'rule' node holds the number and its source, and every step reads it from there. The model has no Pset_DoorCommon.ClearWidth on any door, so the width checked is the IFC OverallWidth of the door (leaf plus frame as exported). Clear width is never larger than that, so a fail is certain and a pass is provisional until clear width is measured. A door with no width is 'unknown' (PassScore empty, grey in both panes), never a pass or a fail. Result: 14 doors, 6 fail (four 762 mm, two 813 mm), 8 pass (six 864 mm, two 1250 mm), 0 unknown. Reading the figure: the histogram counts doors per 50 mm bin of width, red bins lie below 850 and green bins at or above it, and the 'unknown' bar counts doors with no width; the Vega-Lite spec draws the 850 mm rule as a vertical line. The 3D view shares the same red-green scale: failing doors are red and everything else is faded to 15 percent.

doors.sql: SELECT e.EntityIndex, e.StepId, e.GlobalId, e.Type, s.StoreyName AS Storey FROM EntityText e LEFT JOIN StoreyOfElement s ON s.EntityIndex = e.EntityIndex AND s.Depth = 1 WHERE e.Category = 'IFCDOOR' ORDER BY e.StepId

widths.sql: SELECT p.EntityIndex, TRY_CAST(p.Value AS DOUBLE) AS Width_m FROM ParameterText p JOIN EntityText e ON e.EntityIndex = p.EntityIndex WHERE e.Category = 'IFCDOOR' AND p.Name = 'Ifc:OverallWidth'

rule.rows: [{"RuleId":"DC-W1","MinWidth_mm":850.0,"Source":"NBC 2020 3.8.3.12 as cited by samples/nrc/door_verdicts.csv (illustrative, not legal text)"}]

verdicts.sql: SELECT d.StepId, d.GlobalId, d.Storey, d.Type, d.Width_mm, r.MinWidth_mm, r.RuleId, CASE WHEN d.Width_mm IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN d.Width_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS Verdict, CASE WHEN d.Width_mm IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN d.Width_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) END AS PassScore FROM t1 d CROSS JOIN t2 r ORDER BY d.Width_mm NULLS LAST, d.StepId

doorTable.title: Door widths against the 850 mm minimum
doorTable.columns: StepId, GlobalId, Storey, Type, Width_mm, MinWidth_mm, Verdict

histogram.sql: WITH known AS (SELECT CAST(floor(Width_mm / 50) * 50 AS BIGINT) AS BinStart_mm FROM t1 WHERE Width_mm IS NOT NULL), bins AS (SELECT range AS BinStart_mm FROM range((SELECT min(BinStart_mm) FROM known), (SELECT max(BinStart_mm) FROM known) + 50, 50)) SELECT CAST(b.BinStart_mm AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(b.BinStart_mm + 50 AS VARCHAR) || ' mm' AS Bin, b.BinStart_mm, b.BinStart_mm + 50 AS BinEnd_mm, (SELECT count(*) FROM known k WHERE k.BinStart_mm = b.BinStart_mm) AS Doors, CASE WHEN b.BinStart_mm >= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(1 AS DOUBLE) WHEN b.BinStart_mm + 50 <= r.MinWidth_mm THEN CAST(0 AS DOUBLE) ELSE CAST(0.5 AS DOUBLE) END AS PassScore, r.MinWidth_mm FROM bins b CROSS JOIN t2 r UNION ALL SELECT 'unknown', NULL, NULL, (SELECT count(*) FROM t1 WHERE Width_mm IS NULL), NULL, (SELECT MinWidth_mm FROM t2) ORDER BY BinStart_mm NULLS LAST

chart.title: Doors per 50 mm of width (red: below 850 mm)
